covariance: known stationary OU covariance; marginal scales fixed from baseline calibration
start: six wide Hermite-corrected weak moments averaged over the same observations; noisy first observations for initial states
escalation: if norm of relative coefficient bias / mean Fisher relative standard error at n=800 is below 0.3, include 10% and 20% in a separately frozen main protocol
optimizer: bounded local joint Gaussian likelihood, block Gauss-Newton with nuisance Schur elimination
failed_fit_policy: retain diagnostic and stop promotion; no Monte Carlo repetition excluded
